blocks.text:
I'm checking the distance from R41's NH2 atom to nearby protein heavy atoms, excluding those within 2 bonds of it, starting with CD which should be far enough away to count.

So far ARG41 CD comes out to about 2.82 Å, which is allowed since it's 3 bonds away. I'm now scanning other nearby residues—ASP48, GLU67, ARG41's own CG and N, GLN50, LEU42, ASP44—to see if anything else is closer, but none of these seem to be in range based on their coordinates.

The distance to CD checks out through the NH2-CZ-NE-CD path being three bonds, so it qualifies under the rule. I settle on A:R41:CD as the answer, confirming no closer nonlocal atom exists nearby.
